تعديل تنظيمي لمتطلبات الإبلاغ عن موثوقية الشبكة — Grid Reliability Reporting Amendment (DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT — NOT A VERIFIED LEGAL TEXT)
Issued for proof-of-concept demonstration by the Electricity & Cogeneration Regulatory Authority (demonstration). This amendment revises the operational reporting obligations applicable to licensed energy operators and takes effect on 1 January 2027. The following provisions amend and extend the existing Grid Operations Reporting framework.
Article 3 (Amended) — Reporting cadence. Licensed operators shall submit grid reliability performance reports on a monthly basis, replacing the previous quarterly cadence. Each report must cover availability, reserve margin, and frequency-deviation metrics for every transmission region operated.
Article 4 (Amended) — Unplanned-downtime disclosure threshold. The threshold for mandatory disclosure of unplanned downtime is lowered from 60 minutes to 30 minutes of cumulative outage affecting 10 MW or more of load. Events at or above this threshold must be itemised in the monthly report.
Article 5 (New) — Supplier and contractor continuity attestations. Operators shall obtain and retain annual business-continuity attestations from all critical suppliers and contractors supporting grid operations, and shall summarise coverage gaps in each monthly submission.
Article 6 (Amended) — Data retention of operational logs. Operational logs, SCADA records, and reliability datasets underpinning submitted reports shall be retained for a minimum of seven years, extended from the previous five-year requirement, and made available for audit on request.
Article 7 (New) — Executive sign-off. Each monthly reliability report shall be formally reviewed and signed off by an accountable executive officer of the licensed operator prior to submission, confirming completeness and accuracy.
Article 8 (New) — Incident notification timeline. Operators shall notify the Authority of any major grid reliability incident within 24 hours of detection, followed by a full root-cause report within 10 business days.
Article 9 (Amended) — Evidence and audit requirements. Operators shall maintain a traceable evidence trail linking each reported metric to its underlying source records, and shall support independent verification during Authority audits.
This demonstration text is intended solely to exercise the Regulatory Change Intelligence proof of concept and must not be relied upon as an official or binding regulatory instrument.
x_snc_se_grc_vp_0_reg_publication.summary: DEMONSTRATION DATA — This amendment tightens grid reliability and operational reporting obligations for licensed energy operators, shortening reporting cadence and lowering the unplanned-downtime disclosure threshold. It introduces new continuity-attestation and executive sign-off duties and strengthens evidence, data-retention and incident-notification requirements. It is provided for proof-of-concept demonstration only and is not a verified live legal text.
